News Verification : The media had reports that  ICICI Bank Limited /Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited  is looking to acquire The Karnataka Bank Limited. The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the media and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. The Karnataka Bank Limited has vide its letter inter-alia stated, "We deny merger rumour with any Bank as reported in the media".

News Verification : The media had reports that ICICI Bank Limited is looking to acquire The Karnataka Bank Limited.
